Name: Kyuya's Iridium Scythe 1.6 Patch
Author: sugarmaples
Description:
Hello! This is an [b]UNOFFICIAL[/b] update of Kyuya258369's mod "Gorgeous Weapons". It allows the iridium scythe added in 1.6 to be replaced with one of her sprites. You will need to download that mod too, as this ONLY replaces the iridium sprite. 

NOTE: If the iridium scythe looks the SAME as the gold scythe with both mods installed, please go to the config file for [b]KYUYA[/b]'s mod (not this one!) and change the scythe sprite to the golden one. 

Donation Points are turned OFF for this mod, as per Kyuya's page. [b]If you are Kyuya and you would like me to take this down, please let me know here or on 小红书 (ID:6159772224)[/b].

I have a continuation of Kyuya's Iridium Tools Replacements which should be posted here in a few minutes, so check that out if you're interested in her mods!
